description: A React functional component that renders a breadcrumb navigation bar with truncation and tooltip support. It accepts an array of items with labels and optional titles and produces an accessible breadcrumb list.

methods.name: Breadcrumbs({ items, ariaLabel = "Breadcrumb" })
methods.description: A React functional component that renders an accessible breadcrumb navigation with optional truncation and tooltips. It filters out falsy items, determines the last item for styling, and generates labels and titles accordingly.
